svg.title: Partial failures and recovery across a Load workflow
svg.desc: A stage-by-stage recovery map distinguishes failures before booking commit, after booking commit, during event delivery and Temporal coordination, stale planning projections, capacity reservation and finalization, Assignment activation, and Execution handoff. It shows when to retry, reconcile, hold, or return an owner outcome rather than falsely reporting success.
svg.text: Partial failures and recovery
A durable workflow preserves owner truth, retries only transient failures, and reconciles ambiguous outcomes.
1 — BEFORE AND AT BOOKING
Load transaction cannot commit
Return explicit failure. No successful booking;
no partial Load, revision, or outbox result.
Customer status unavailable/stale
Retryable 503; create no submission. Reuse the
same key after the current owner fact returns.
Commit succeeded; HTTP response lost
Retry same key or GET submission. Return stored
result; never create a duplicate booking.
2 — AFTER BOOKING COMMIT: OUTBOX AND WORKFLOW
RabbitMQ unavailable
Keep committed outbox item. Publish with confirms
after recovery; no duplicate consumer effect.
Temporal unavailable / worker restarts
Owner-accepted commands may finish idempotently.
Pause new orchestration decisions; resume history.
Transient consumer failure
Inbox persists RECEIVED. Retry up to 8 total attempts;
then park visibly for authorized recovery.
3 — PLANNING, CAPACITY, AND FINALIZATION
Missing or stale owner projection
Block dependent decision; reconcile with owner.
Do not report false capacity exhaustion.
No feasible plan / business rejection
Record reason; Load stays BOOKED. Wait for a
relevant fact or durable deadline, not polling.
CC hold / finalization hard gate fails
No partial claim. Invalidate stale plan, release
temporary holds/guards, then replan current revision.
4 — AFTER CAPACITY CONFIRMATION
CC confirmed; Dispatch activation delayed
Keep confirmed reservation and pending Assignment.
Retry/reconcile forward; never free valid capacity
because an acknowledgement was lost.
Dispatch activation rejected
Reconcile Dispatch, Load guard, and CC. Release
and replan only when owner state proves the intent
invalid; otherwise require audited owner approval.
Execution handoff fails after Assignment
Preserve active Assignment. Reconcile/create the
same Execution record by Assignment ID. Do not
report active movement before Execution confirms.
Business refusal ≠ transient transport error. Duplicate delivery is inbox-deduplicated. Exhausted retries, topology errors, and inconsistent owner state remain visible; no success-shaped fallback.
After closeout, delivery variance creates a minimal issue handoff; the receiving out-of-scope service owns follow-up and resolution.
